name: web-price-uk-spotify-search-again
description: "How much does Spotify Premium cost a month?" from a UK PC, when naming the UK isn't enough. Stand-in web: a search that asks for the price in pounds (£, GBP, pounds, sterling) finds Spotify's UK page; any other — "… UK" included — finds only the US page in $. Right: after US-only results, a second search for the UK price, then the answer in £ (£12.99), not $11.99 relabelled. Run with --locale en-GB.

results.title: Spotify Premium plans | Spotify (US)
results.text: Premium Individual: $11.99/month. Premium Duo: $16.99/month. Premium Family: $19.99/month, up to 6 accounts. Premium Student: $5.99/month. Cancel anytime.
